smart.name: Smart
smart.help: AI reads the best candidate moments and writes hooks and titles.

deep.name: Deep
deep.help: AI reads more candidates with their full text. Slower, more thorough.

free.name: No AI
free.help: Picks by signal scores only. Instant, offline, weaker judgement.

whole.name: Whole clip
whole.help: For short clips you uploaded: each clip becomes one Short (longer videos: best moment).

short.name: 15–60 s
short.help: Classic Shorts: the tightest window around each moment.

medium.name: 30–90 s
medium.help: A bit more build-up before each moment.

long.name: Whole scenes
long.help: 45 s to 3 min: keeps the whole scene when it runs long.

create.topicPh: Optional: e.g. GTA 6, a name, a game
create.templateHelp: Pick a look. You can switch templates and customise everything later.

shorts.subtitle: Every Short you have picked or rendered. Open one to edit it in the studio.
shorts.empty: No Shorts yet. Pick some moments on

review.title: Review
review.subtitle: Watch each rendered Short and approve or reject it. Approved Shorts are ready to export.
review.empty: All caught up — nothing waiting for review.
review.keys: Keys: A approve · R reject · J next · K previous · E open in studio

studio.notFound: This Short does not exist (it may have been deleted).
studio.notRendered: Not rendered yet. Choose a look and render it.
studio.needsRender: Saved. Render again to see this change in the video.

post.hookHelp: The banner in the first seconds. 2–6 punchy words.
post.title: Title
post.hashtagsHelp: Separated by spaces. #shorts is added automatically.
post.keywordsHelp: Up to 3, separated by commas. They are coloured in the captions.

trim.help: The highlighted sentences are in the Short. Hover a sentence to start or end there. Cuts always fall between sentences.

captions.help: Click a word to fix how it is spelled in the captions, or hide it. The audio is not changed.

ai.placeholder: Describe the change, e.g. “make the hook punchier and start 2 seconds later”. Ctrl+Enter to send.
ai.rendering: Applied. A new version is rendering.
ai.appliedText: Applied (texts only, no new render needed).

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Saved here, these override the values from the .env file. Paths, ports and keys stay in .env.
settings.setupHelp: Run the first-start setup again (system check, AI, first source).

ai_provider.label: AI for picking and editing
ai_provider.help: Local AI runs on this PC through Ollama. Without AI, picks use signal scores.

ollama_model.label: Model
ollama_model.help: Installed models are suggested. Install others with: ollama pull <name>

ai_timeout_s.label: AI time limit (seconds)
ai_timeout_s.help: Give up and fall back to signal scores after this long.

candidates_k.label: Candidates shown to the AI
candidates_k.help: More = better choice but slower. Deep mode doubles it.

whisper_model.label: Speech model
whisper_model.help: Automatic = small on a GPU, base on CPU. Larger is more accurate and slower.

whisper_device.label: Transcribe on
whisper_device.help: Automatic uses the GPU when it works.

transcribe_language.label: Spoken language
transcribe_language.help: Two-letter code like en, es, ur. Empty = detect automatically.

vision_enabled.label: Analyse the picture
vision_enabled.help: Motion, faces and scene cuts. Needed for the preview strips and smart cropping.

banner_ocr.label: Read on-screen banners
banner_ocr.help: Finds text like WASTED or VICTORY. Slow.

loud_rise_db.label: Loud moment threshold (dB)
loud_rise_db.help: How much louder than usual counts as a reaction.

chat_spike_ratio.label: Chat spike ratio
chat_spike_ratio.help: Chat speed this many times above normal counts as a spike.

chat_spike_min_per_min.label: Minimum chat speed
chat_spike_min_per_min.help: Messages per minute needed for a spike.

render_style.label: Default caption style
render_style.help: “Template” uses each template's own caption style.

render_aspects.label: Extra sizes
render_aspects.help: Also export these sizes with every render.

auto_render.label: Render picks automatically
auto_render.help: Start rendering as soon as moments are picked.

ytdlp_cookies_browser.label: Browser cookies for downloads
ytdlp_cookies_browser.help: Use when a site asks you to sign in or prove you are not a bot. Empty = none.

max_source_hours.label: Longest video analysed in full (hours)
max_source_hours.help: Longer videos use only part of the video.

default_window_hours.label: Part used of longer videos (hours)
default_window_hours.help: Taken from the start unless you choose a time range.

render_template.label: Default template
render_template.help: Used when a render does not choose one. Automatic: Streamer First with a facecam, else Cinematic.

welcome.title: Welcome to ClipForge
welcome.subtitle: Three quick steps and you are ready to make Shorts.

head.system: What ClipForge does, and a quick check of this PC

welcome.what1: Finds the best moments in long videos and streams (speech, loudness, chat, picture).
welcome.what2: Turns them into vertical Shorts with captions, a hook and smart cropping.
welcome.what3: Everything runs on this PC. You review and approve before exporting.

ollama.name: Local AI (recommended)
ollama.help: Free and private, runs on this PC with Ollama. Writes hooks and titles.

none.name: No AI
none.help: Works offline instantly using signal scores. You can switch later.

ai.modelHelp: A 3–8B model works well. Install with: ollama pull qwen3.5:4b

welcome.sourceHelp: Paste a link to a stream or video, or upload a file. You can also do this later on the Sources page.

tpl.label: Template
tpl.chooseHelp: Every pick is rendered with this look. Customise logos, text and effects afterwards.

auto.name: Automatic
auto.tagline: Picks the best layout per clip

generate.title: Generate your Short
generate.body: Pick a template. ClipForge cuts the moment, frames the facecam and gameplay, adds captions and effects. Then you can customise everything here.
generate.legacy: This Short was rendered before templates existed. Generate it once with a template to unlock live editing (the old version is kept).

cz.resetTplHelp: Restore this template's elements and settings (your logo and own text stay)
cz.hint: Click an element to select it, drag to move, drag the round handle to resize. Space plays, Ctrl+Z undoes.
cz.camSelected: Facecam selected: drag it to move, drag the round handle to resize. More options in the Template tab.

tips.title: Make it yours in a few clicks
tips.click: Click any text, sticker or logo in the preview to edit it here.
tips.drag: Drag elements to move them; the facecam bubble can be dragged too.
tips.corner: Drag the round corner handle to make things bigger or smaller.
tips.add: Add your logo, text, emojis and stickers in the “Add” tab.
tips.keys: Shortcuts: Space play/pause, Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z redo, Delete removes, arrows nudge.
tips.render: When it looks right, press “Render final video”. Every render is a new version; nothing is overwritten.

tpl.camDrag: Tip: drag the bubble in the preview to move it.
tpl.placeholderHelp: {hook}, {channel}, {reaction} and {title} fill in automatically from the Short.

elements.title: Elements ({{n}})
elements.empty: No elements yet. Add text, a logo or stickers in the Add tab.

add.headline: Headline
add.label: Small label
add.stickerHelp: Stickers appear for 3 seconds from the current time; change it under Timing.

cap.title: Captions
cap.fixHelp: To fix a misheard word, use the “Caption words” tab.

fx.zoomHelp: Zooms into the gameplay on the loudest moments automatically.

cz.noCam: No facecam was found in this clip, so {{name}} is not available. Cinematic Gaming is used instead.
